statement: When range_30 <= 0.00110421 (discovery q=0.1) AND avg_rv_30 <= 0.000694436 (discovery q=0.1), the conditioned symbols' forward return in excess of the universe average over the next 1 bars (entering one bar after the signal) is negative.

mechanisms.name: risk_compensation
mechanisms.explanation: higher recent volatility is paid as a short-horizon risk premium

mechanisms.name: liquidity_withdrawal
mechanisms.explanation: liquidity providers widen quotes after volatility, then revert

prediction.measure: the conditioned symbols' forward return in excess of the universe average

invalidation.rule: fewer than 60% of walk-forward folds share the sign
the effect appears with a time-shifted condition
